## Engine changes

### `src/v3/actions/families.js`

Root causes: `ELIGIBILITY_STARVATION (v4f-09)`

movement/isolation canSelect gates become low floors with continuous weight tapers; HANDOFF reads null height as UNKNOWN with a positional fallback; MOVEMENT_FAMILY_ACTIONS/isMovementFamilyAction exported as the single definition of the movement family

### `src/v3/calibration/calibrationPlayerAdapter.js`

Root causes: `ELIGIBILITY_STARVATION (v4f-09)`, `INPUT_QUALITY_COMPRESSION (v4f-02, v4f-08)`, `DEFENSIVE_PROXY_INVERSION (v4f-03/04/06/07)`

offBallMovement reads perimeter craft + efficient finishing + role, not a three-point grade; scoring volume reads points per game alongside FGA; efficiency reads TS% or a labelled FG%/FT% estimate centred on the store-population median; interior diet from the two-point split or documented three volume; post threat falls back to recorded total boards; documented defensive bands become position-scoped floors in every era

### `src/v3/defense/plan.js`

Root causes: `COACH_DEPLOYMENT_SATURATION (zone step)`

the zone shell is built whenever a legal shell exists and the coach zones at all, instead of only above the 5/10 step

### `src/v3/defense/scheme.js`

Root causes: `COACH_DEPLOYMENT_SATURATION (zone step)`

manShellType records what the defence plays when not in its zone, so the per-possession ledger label can be truthful

### `src/v3/possession/game.js`

Root causes: `COACH_DEPLOYMENT_SATURATION (zone step)`

zone use is a per-possession draw, continuous in the coach zone scale (p = (zoneUsage/10)^1.35 * 0.8); the standing offensive plan is built against man; zone possessions replace the plan mix

### `src/v3/possession/actions.js`

Root causes: `COACH_DEPLOYMENT_SATURATION (zone step)`

schemeId is per-possession truth: ZONE:<shell> on zone possessions, the man fallback label otherwise

### `src/v3/actions/offensivePlan.js`

Root causes: `COACH_DEPLOYMENT_SATURATION (zone step)`

a standing zone-attack plan is built only when the defence zones a material share of possessions

### `src/v3/teamIntelligence.js`

Root causes: `OFFENSIVE_GLASS_CHANNEL_MISWIRED (v4f-05)`

offensiveGlass carries offensive-board evidence (postThreat) alongside board-craft, instead of defensive rebounding and position alone
